title: Why it sucks being an Antwerp fan

scenes.text: Why it sucks being an... Antwerp fan!
It starts when you're six. Your dad says: "We're the oldest club in Belgium. Number one!" He mentions it. Constantly.
Age eight. The oldest club in Belgium... plays in the second division. Your dad stops mentioning it.
Age nine. Promoted! After thirteen years! Your dad mentions it again. Constantly.
Age twelve. You win the cup! Your dad says: "Nice. But our last league title was 1957."
Age fifteen. Last day of the season. Ninety-fourth minute. Your defender scores a volley. Champions! After sixty-six years! Sorry, Genk fans.
Age sixteen. Champions League. You beat Barcelona! Barcelona! You still finish last in the group.
That's the thing about being an Antwerp fan. The oldest club in Belgium... and sixty-six years to win the league.
But when it finally happens... it happens in the ninety-fourth minute. Your dad still hasn't calmed down.
Tag an Antwerp fan. The Great Old. And which club is next? Drop it in the comments!
